_readme: Seed for the film_links table. Authored by Leonard (chat side) from film_lessons and film_session_notes on 2026-08-01. Films referenced by title+year; resolve to film_titles ids at insert time and fail loudly on any miss. All rows source=hand-authored. weight: 3=strong named bloodline, 2=solid, 1=soft. directional=true means the note reads from->to only. The note text is the see-also line rendered on the back of the 'from' photo; keep it verbatim, it is written in the ritual's voice. No em dashes anywhere in notes, ever.

links.note: Same desert, same dread, same refusal to flinch. Sicario is what happens when every hand closes.
The sequel, queued with expectations pre-lowered. No Villeneuve, no Kate.
Comparably insane ideas. One opened a door and made him look, one had a doctor explain a chart. 5.4 versus 9.4 is the whole doctrine.
A Malignant-rule double violation: decoy hour plus exposition dump. Not a reveal, a zoom. Took the floor at 5.2.
Equal weirdness, opposite bill. Coherence made him care about someone in the room and Annihilation held everyone at arm's length. 8.9 versus 7.4.
Both staged the impossible. Only one made the people matter before the strangeness ate them.
Neighbors in The Sevens. Idea-forward, visually lovely, ensemble kept deliberately thin, and he docks for it every time.
He grew up on the copies, not the originals. The Game paid the antibodies tax at 6.8; Memento is the machine the copies were built from.
Begins states the Ra's thesis. The two ferries run the small experiment.
The ferries were the rehearsal. Rises runs the experiment city-wide for months.
The trilogy closes its own loop: he sided with Ra's in Begins, and Rises is that plan actually being run.
He forgot the Talia reveal completely and got to have it twice. God bless a bad memory. The Memento thesis, lived.
The Villeneuve spine. Two registers, same total control, tied and adjacent at the top of the board.
Villeneuve's small strange one against his colossus. Same director, opposite scale.
Garland twice. Ex Machina closes its hand in one room. Annihilation opens it and lets the meaning shimmer away.
Her completes the AI-feelings trilogy in the queue. The cold half and the warm half of the same question.
The Coherence lane: no money, all brains. Vast of Night is queued in it.
Same family: structure as the stimulant. Three sprints at the same twenty minutes. Tabled by the sovereign; only he raises it.
Two operators who never miss. One is the system working, one is a man feeding on it.
The fun shelf, proven understocked and then stocked. Failure as the funniest material versus mayhem as choreography.
Los Angeles twice: once as a punchline, once as a predator. The pick that proved counterprogramming his dread lane works.
A man builds a system of meaning to avoid what he already knows. Sam's conspiracy and Leonard's notes are the same machine. The owl woman memory test proved it within twelve hours.
The two great-conversation mid-scores. Rich debriefs, ambient sprawl, hands that never fully close. Discussion value and rating are separate currencies.
Salieri and the Joker: both defined entirely by the thing they cannot stop watching.
The blockbuster wing: engineering you can feel. One builds the machine for sincerity, one for mischief.
The audacious-execution lane at full volume. Worlds that should not work, run with total command.
Group watches skew crowd-pleaser. Obsession was more John and Tori's speed; his solo lane runs headier.
The 8.3 carries the split-watch asterisk. Never split a tension movie across two nights; the held breath breaks. His lesson, stated by him.
